settings.blurb: Heavyweight cotton washed until the black went grey at the seams, then torn off at the hem and left there. Violet and bone piping runs the shoulder and curves down the body. The wordmark is sprayed rather than printed — it drips because it was meant to.
settings.spec:
Heavyweight cotton, stone washed
Boxy body, dropped shoulder
Hem torn off, threads left on
Sprayed wordmark front, starburst back

settings.blurb: A full-zip hood in faded black, heavy enough to hold its own shape. The joke is set across the chest in pink over a silver star; the wordmark is sprayed across the back, big enough to read from the other side of the room.
settings.spec:
Brushed fleece, heavyweight
Full zip, lined hood
Dropped shoulder, roomy sleeve
Chest print front, wordmark back

settings.blurb: Rigid mid-wash denim cut wide from the hip down and left long enough to stack over a shoe. The wordmark is worked into the thigh the way a tour shirt carries it, with sparks, stars and a barcode thrown across the rest of the leg.
settings.spec:
Rigid denim, mid wash
Wide leg, long inseam
Print across thigh and back pocket
Wordmark at the waistband
